_comment: Reference parameters for lammps-msd-diffusion-audit. The verifier re-derives every reference number at verify time by re-fitting the hash-pinned assets/msd.dat itself; this file carries only tolerances, the fit window, the expected audit verdicts, and asset hashes. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-msd-diffusion-audit:ci (lammps/lammps:patch_7Jan2022 base, python 3.8, numpy 1.24.4).
_asset_note: Only the evidence files are hash-pinned. diffusion_summary.txt and msd_analysis.png are deliberately left unpinned: rerunning the colleague's analyze_msd.py regenerates (overwrites) both, and the agent is allowed — encouraged — to do that while auditing. The verifier's reference fit reads only the pinned files (msd.dat, in.lammps).
_calibration_note: Verifier self-fit of assets/msd.dat (50-100 ps closed interval, straight line with intercept, dt = 2.0 fs parsed from in.lammps): slope = 3.6765 A^2/ps, intercept = -24.36 A^2, R^2 = 0.99771, D = 6.128e-5 cm^2/s, n = 101 (agent-reported n accepted in 99-101 to cover endpoint conventions; the 2% D/slope bands absorb the 0.3% difference). Decoys: colleague headline 1.7124e-4 cm^2/s (slope/2 over the 100-500 ps window coded in assets/analyze_msd.py) and right-factor-wrong-window 5.708e-5 cm^2/s; both lie >6% outside the 2% acceptance band around 6.128e-5. A forced-origin fit (5.606e-5, 8.5% off) also fails the D band. Data is static, so the oracle is deterministic (3/3 identical). Agent-facing schema is the minimal 4-key results.json (D, slope, R^2, n_fit_points).
